<h2>Build Trait Review Policy Outputs</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds proposed decisions, a bounded agent-review queue, and policy summaries
from all-domain trait-review recommendations without approving decisions.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_trait_review_policy_outputs(
  data_candidate_recommendations,
  evidence_reference,
  max_agent_candidates_per_domain = 25L,
  agent_batch_size = 25L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate_recommendations">data_candidate_recommendations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate recommendations returned by
[diagnose_trait_review_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="evidence_reference">evidence_reference</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty reference to the policy report supporting the proposals.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="max_agent_candidates_per_domain">max_agent_candidates_per_domain</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum number of targeted agent-review candidates retained per domain.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="agent_batch_size">agent_batch_size</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum number of candidates assigned to one agent batch.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing 'data_policy_proposals',
'data_agent_review_queue', and 'data_policy_summary'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>recommendations &lt;- tibble::tibble(
  candidate_id = digest::digest(
    "raw|Taxon A|Diaspore mass",
    algo = "sha256",
    serialize = FALSE
  ),
  taxon_name = "Taxon A",
  trait_domain_name = "Diaspore mass",
  n_records_current = 1L,
  deterministic_outcome = "retain_flagged_uncertain",
  suggested_action = "none",
  acceptance_eligibility = "eligible_policy_acceptance",
  recommendation_rationale = "No objective error evidence.",
  candidate_impact_score = 0.5
)
build_trait_review_policy_outputs(
  recommendations,
  evidence_reference = "report.html"
)
</code></pre>
